name: Codex cache multipliers -> cacheCreate always priced at 0 (no write billing), cacheRead at 0.10x input
_comment: Pins the Codex-specific cache multiplier row from the design doc (section 3): codex {write: 0, read: 0.10} vs claude {write: 1.25, read: 0.10}. Uses gpt-5.4 (input $2.50/M, output $15.00/M). cache_creation_input_tokens is nonzero here on purpose -- ingestion always emits 0 for Codex records (design doc section 2), but the PRICING layer must still treat a nonzero cache-write class as worth $0, not fall back to the input rate. future-dated so today/thisWeek/rolling5h stay 0 (TZ-independent, same trick as the other provider fixtures).
